title: Reverse String
description: Given a string, return the string in reverse order.

examples.explanation: The characters of the string are reversed.
The characters are returned in reverse order.

hints: Think about how you can remember numbers you have already seen.
For each number, check whether target - number has already been seen.
Can you solve this in one pass using a hash map?
editorial: Traverse the string from the end to the beginning and construct the reversed string. An alternative is to use two pointers and swap characters from both ends.
